commit.message:
fix(diag): relocate lockfile to root directory and harden module/process cleanup

Address review feedback on diag.sh: move the shared lockfile to /run/anticheat-diag.lock, avoid marking module ownership until insmod succeeds, prevent fd 9 inheritance in background processes, clean up child subshell on exit, and restore the kprobe filter in dmesg.

Generated-By: pr-autopilot (agy, gemini-3.8-flash-medium)

fix(build): diag.sh checks for root and only unloads a module it loaded (#93)

diag.sh documented itself as needing root but never checked, and ran rmmod anticheat unconditionally before loading and again at the end. Run against a live system, that silently unloaded the running anticheat. Add the id -u guard test.sh already uses, diagnose an already-loaded module in place, and move teardown into an EXIT trap that only rmmods a module this run insmod'ed.

Generated-By: pr-autopilot (opencode, opencode/beam-free)

fix(diag): harden cleanup, locking, and error reporting

Address CodeRabbit review threads on diag.sh: report unprotect/rmmod failures, reap stopped children, avoid unloading replaced modules, serialize concurrent runs, and close ownership race during insmod.

commit.message:
Revert play-count rollback on failed playback (out of scope for PR #8)

Remove the play-statistics snapshot and rollback added in 7e92b74, keeping only the playback-error reporting. Per the out-of-scope changes check, track any rollback feature in a separate PR.

Generated-By: pr-autopilot (opencode, opencode/beam-free)

Report playback errors to the window

GStreamer reports a damaged or unsupported file on its bus, after
play_file has already returned. The immediate player.error check in the
window could never see it, so the footer stayed on the pause icon and
the now-playing label while nothing was playing.

Give Player an on_error callback, delivered on the GTK main loop like the
gapless hand-off, and reset the footer and show the message when it
fires.

Generated-By: pr-autopilot (opencode, opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free)

Don't report an earlier track's error after the user moved on

_notify_error only checked that the player was STOPPED, so if track A
failed and the user started and stopped track B before A's idle callback
ran, A's error still showed. Every play_file() and stop() now bumps a
play id, and the callback reports only if its id is still current.
